simple.meaning: חׇרְבָּה (chorbâh) appears 42 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Leviticus, Ezra, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, and 4 more, beginning at Leviticus 26:31. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as offering, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חׇרְבָּה (H2723) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חׇרְבָּה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: חׇרְבָּה (chorbâh) / H2723 is tracked through Leviticus 26:31, Leviticus 26:33, Ezra 9:9, Job 3:14. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H2723. chorbah חָרְבָּה noun feminine waste, desolation, ruin ; — absolute ׳ח Lev 26:31 15 t. + Ezek 38:8 (strike out ᵑ6 Co) + 38:12 ᵐ5 חרבה Co for חרבות ; plural חֳרָבוֺת Psa 9:7 11 t. ( Ezek 38:12 , compare above); construct חָרְבוֺת Isa 5:17 7 t.; suffix חָרְבֹתַיִךְ 49:19 ; חָרְבֹתָיו Ezra 9:9 ; חָרְבֹתֶיהָ Isa 51:3 ; חָרְבוֺתֶיהָ 44:26 ; חָרְבוֺתֵיהֶם Psa 109:10 2Chr 34:6 (compare חֶרֶב and below); (chiefly mid. and late Hebrew Isa 2 8t.; Jeremiah 10 t., Ezekiel 14 t. — including Ezek 38:8 , q. strike out Co); — 1 waste, ruin , of cities of Israel Lev 26:31 , 33 (H); Judah Isa 44:26 ; 49:19 (|| שֹׁמְמֹת ), 58:12 ( בנה ), Jer 25:18 ; 27:17 ; 44:2 , 6 ; Ezek 5:14 ; ruins of Jerusalem Isa 52:9 ; Dan 9:2 ; also Ezek 35:4 ; compare Mal 1:4 (with בנה ), Ezek 36:10 (with בנה ) 36:33 ( id. ); Egypt 29:9-10 , (in both || שְׁמָמָה ; חֹרֶב חרבות in 29:10 ); ruin of temple Ezra 9:9 ; = ruined dwellings Psa 109:10 ; compare 2Chr 34:6 , where read perhaps בְּחָרְבֹתֵיהֶם for בתיהם בּחר (see חֶרֶב below III. חרב ); Jer 22:5 ; in General ruins (si vera 1., see Di; object of בנה ) Job 3:14 ; ח ׳כוס Psa 102:7 an owl of a ruin . 2 of land: waste place amid ruins Isa 5:17 , compare 51:3 (|| עֲרָבָה מִדְבָּר, ); land a desolation Jer 7:34 ; 44:22 ; Ezek 25:13 (Edom) Jer 25:11 ; Isa 64:10 and Ezek 33:24 , 27 (of Judah), compare 13:4 , בח ׳כְשֻׁעָלִים simile of the prophets; ׳הח הַשֹּׁמֵמוֺת 36:4 (of Israel); of desolation of enemies of Israel Psa 9:7 ( ׳ח לָנֶ֫צַח ); ׳ח עולם = old ruins Isa 61:4 (with בנה ); elsewhere perpetual ruin, desolation Jer 25:9 ; 49:13 (cities of Bosra); ׳ה מעולם Ezek 26:20 (simile of Tyre).
